(* SHA256_Compress.sha256_rounds_correct *)
lemma sha256_rounds_correct:
  forall (h0 m : JWord.W32.t List.list),
    hoare[ HashExtracted.M.__sha256_rounds :
            SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ SHA256_Compress.mwords w = m ==>
            SHA256_Compress.hwords res = FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0 m ].

(* SHA256_Compress.sha256_compress_correct *)
lemma sha256_compress_correct:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (blk : BArray64.t),
    hoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_compress :
            SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
            SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
            FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
              (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be32
                 (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 4 (BArray64.to_list blk)))
            ].

(* SHA256_Compress.sha256_compress_total *)
lemma sha256_compress_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (blk : BArray64.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_compress :
             SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
             SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
               (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be32
                  (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 4 (BArray64.to_list blk)))] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA256_Blocks.sha256_compress_one_total *)
lemma sha256_compress_one_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (p0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_compress_one :
             SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\
             p = p0 /\
             Int.(<=) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) 64)
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
               (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be32
                  (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 4
                     (SHA512_Blocks.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                        (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) 64)))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA256_Blocks.sha256_compress_blocks_total *)
lemma sha256_compress_blocks_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (p0 n0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_compress_blocks :
             SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\
             p = p0 /\
             n = n0 /\
             Int.(<)
               (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                  (Int.( * ) 64 (JWord.W64.to_uint n0)))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
             List.foldl FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
               (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.parse
                  (SHA512_Blocks.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                     (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                     (Int.( * ) 64 (JWord.W64.to_uint n0))))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA256_Stream.sha256_absorb_mem_total *)
lemma sha256_absorb_mem_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes) (p0
    l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_absorb_mem :
             SHA256_Stream.stream256 h0 m h buf total /\
             in_0 = p0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size m) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             SHA256_Stream.stream256 h0
               (List.(++) m
                  (SHA512_Blocks.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                     (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))) res.`1
               res.`2 res.`3] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA256_Stream.sha256_finalize_total *)
lemma sha256_finalize_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_finalize :
             SHA256_Stream.stream256 h0 m h buf total /\
             Int.(<) (List.size m) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             ADRS.bytes_of res.`1 =
             List.flatten
               (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w32_be (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.hash h0 m))] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA256_Stream.sha256_mem_total *)
lemma sha256_mem_total:
  forall (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_mem :
             in_0 = p0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             ADRS.bytes_of res.`1 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.sha256
               (SHA512_Blocks.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA256_Stream.sha224_mem_total *)
lemma sha224_mem_total:
  forall (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),

(* HMAC_SHA256.hmac_sha256_blocks *)
lemma hmac_sha256_blocks:
  forall (k text : Bytes.bytes),
    Int.(<=) (List.size k) 64 =>
    FIPS198_HMAC.hmac_sha256 k text =
    FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.sha256
      (List.(++)
         (FIPS198_HMAC.xorb
            (List.(++) k (Bytes.zeros (Int.(-) 64 (List.size k))))
            (FIPS198_HMAC.opad 64))
         (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.sha256
            (List.(++)
               (FIPS198_HMAC.xorb
                  (List.(++) k (Bytes.zeros (Int.(-) 64 (List.size k))))
                  (FIPS198_HMAC.ipad 64)) text))).

               (FIPS180_SHA2_Blocks.words256

                     (FIPS198_HMAC.ipad 64))) /\
             SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`2 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.H0_256
               (FIPS180_SHA2_Blocks.words256
                  (FIPS198_HMAC.xorb (BArray64.to_list K)
                     (FIPS198_HMAC.opad 64)))] = (Real.(%r) 1).
